properties.name: spring.graphql.cors.allow-credentials
properties.description: Whether credentials are supported. When not set, credentials are not supported.

properties.name: spring.graphql.cors.allowed-headers
properties.description: List of HTTP headers to allow in a request. '*' allows all headers.

properties.name: spring.graphql.cors.allowed-methods
properties.description: List of HTTP methods to allow. '*' allows all methods. When not set, defaults to GET.

properties.name: spring.graphql.cors.allowed-origin-patterns
properties.description: List of origin patterns to allow. Unlike allowed origins which only support '*', origin patterns are more flexible, e.g. 'https://*.example.com', and can be used with allow-credentials. When neither allowed origins nor allowed origin patterns are set, cross-origin requests are effectively disabled.

properties.name: spring.graphql.cors.allowed-origins
properties.description: List of origins to allow with '*' allowing all origins. When allow-credentials is enabled, '*' cannot be used, and setting origin patterns should be considered instead. When neither allowed origins nor allowed origin patterns are set, cross-origin requests are effectively disabled.

properties.name: spring.graphql.cors.exposed-headers
properties.description: List of headers to include in a response.

properties.name: spring.graphql.cors.max-age
properties.description: How long the response from a pre-flight request can be cached by clients. If a duration suffix is not specified, seconds will be used.

properties.name: spring.graphql.graphiql.enabled
properties.description: Whether the default GraphiQL UI is enabled.

properties.name: spring.graphql.graphiql.path
properties.description: Path to the GraphiQL UI endpoint.

properties.name: spring.graphql.http.path
properties.description: Path at which to expose a GraphQL request HTTP endpoint.

properties.name: spring.graphql.http.sse.keep-alive
properties.description: How frequently keep-alive messages should be sent.

properties.name: spring.graphql.http.sse.timeout
properties.description: Time required for concurrent handling to complete.

properties.name: spring.graphql.rsocket.mapping
properties.description: Mapping of the RSocket message handler.

properties.name: spring.graphql.rsocket.preferred-json-mapper
properties.description: Preferred JSON mapper to use. By default, auto-detected according to the environment. Supported values are 'jackson' and 'jackson2' (deprecated).

properties.name: spring.graphql.schema.additional-files
properties.description: Locations of additional, individual schema files to parse.

properties.name: spring.graphql.schema.file-extensions
properties.description: File extensions for GraphQL schema files.

properties.name: spring.graphql.schema.inspection.enabled
properties.description: Whether schema should be compared to the application to detect missing mappings.

properties.name: spring.graphql.schema.introspection.enabled
properties.description: Whether field introspection should be enabled at the schema level.

properties.name: spring.graphql.schema.locations
properties.description: Locations of GraphQL schema files.

properties.name: spring.graphql.schema.printer.enabled
properties.description: Whether the endpoint that prints the schema is enabled. Schema is available under spring.graphql.http.path + "/schema".

properties.name: spring.graphql.websocket.connection-init-timeout
properties.description: Time within which the initial {@code CONNECTION_INIT} type message must be received.

properties.name: spring.graphql.websocket.keep-alive
properties.description: Maximum idle period before a server keep-alive ping is sent to client.

properties.name: spring.graphql.websocket.path
properties.description: Path of the GraphQL WebSocket subscription endpoint.

properties.name: management.metrics.graphql.autotime.enabled
properties.description: Whether to automatically time web client requests.

properties.name: management.metrics.graphql.autotime.percentiles
properties.description: Computed non-aggregable percentiles to publish.

properties.name: management.metrics.graphql.autotime.percentiles-histogram
properties.description: Whether percentile histograms should be published.
